name: Taller Experimental de Gráfica de La Habana
known: The muralist Orlando Suárez was its first director.
Nine directors since 1962, the latest Yamilys Brito Jorge (OnCuba, 2022).
ACN quoted her as director in 2025.
The CNAP's 2013 page describes a print workshop that sells prints and commissions, naming only its director, Luis Ramón Lara Calaña.
Moved to Callejón del Chorro in the 1990s; it has had nine directors since 1962, the latest Yamilys Brito (OnCuba, 2022).

name: Universidad de las Artes de Cuba (ISA)
known: Getty Foundation: a Keeping It Modern grant announced on 11 October 2018 for the National Art Schools, to pay for historical documentation, materials studies and a conservation management plan (The Art Newspaper).
The university's cooperation page lists five international projects, including ¡Que no baje el telón! with Italy and a conservation plan for the art schools with the Fundación Politécnico di Milano.

name: Unión de Escritores y Artistas de Cuba (UNEAC)
Museo Provincial La Periquera
known: EcuRed says the name comes from the cry "Salgan de la jaula, pericos" shouted by besiegers in 1868, when Spanish forces and conservative families sheltered in the building.

name: Teatro Sauto
known: A Salón de los Espejos holds 150, and the building has a protocol room and paper conservation and restoration laboratories (EcuRed, OnCuba).
A specialist of the provincial culture directorate in Matanzas spoke for the theatre's festival programme in 2022 (Girón).
The national heritage council gave the restoration its 2020 National Restoration Prize (OnCuba, 2021) and was consulted by the director on the 2024 to 2025 ceiling repair (ACN via Girón, 2025).

2010 to 2018 repairs: OnCuba says they renewed technical and service systems, signage and disabled access (27 February 2021); former director Cecilia Sodis Carrillo, in post from 1989 to 2016, set about restoring the theatre from 2001 (OnCuba, 6 April 2021).

2024 to 2025 repair: ACN reported a moderate crack in the false ceiling of the stalls, which it attributed to ageing materials, heat, humidity and vibration; the work re-plastered the muses and anchored the ceiling with more than 70 cured-wood ties, and director Kalec Acosta said air conditioning, r
Its director consulted the Consejo Nacional de Patrimonio on the 2024 to 2025 ceiling repair (ACN via Girón, 12 July 2025).

name: Museo Provincial de Pinar del Río
known: EcuRed names María de las Nieves Ramos Gómez as director (undated).

Granma reported on 15 July 2026 that provincial heritage director José Manuel Fernández Paulín said the Provincial History Museum was among buildings being restored on Martí Street ahead of the 26 July commemoration.

name: Escuela Internacional de Cine y Televisión (EICTV)
known: OnCuba names Gabriel García Márquez, Fernando Birri and Julio García Espinosa as its founders.

AFP, 28 November 2011 (via El Universo): the state financed the school entirely until the 1990s special period; it then supplied one third of the budget, which director Rafael Rosal put at 3.5 to 4 million dollars a year.

name: Museo del Humor
known: Jury president Ismael Lema told the press that 890 works from 246 artists in 44 countries were received and 233 competed, and museum director Jesús Víctores sat on the jury (Cubaperiodistas).

The Bienal is organised by the Unión de Periodistas de Cuba and the museum, with co-sponsorship from Artemisa's provincial culture directorate (OnCuba, 2023) and the Consejo Nacional de las Artes Plásticas (Cubaperiodistas, 2025).

Eddy Michel Leyva Marrero, a vice-intendant of the municipal administration, said the Parque del Humor and the museum were restored for the 2025 Bienal and that the logistics had business-sector support (Cubaperiodistas).

name: Museo Castillo del Morro San Pedro de la Roca
known: UNESCO noted conservation problems in 1997, mainly degraded wooden elements, eroded walls and plant growth.

name: Museo Romántico de Trinidad
known: Escambray, 2024: the museum has always had support for its conservation, which the article ties to political will, but despite the revenue it raises each year has no financing for structural repairs or new acquisitions; the article puts this in its paragraph on director Isabel Rueda.
In the Sancti Spíritus heritage network; its director told Escambray in 2024 it has no funding for repairs or acquisitions despite yearly takings.

name: MeetFactory
known: Three galleries (the MeetFactory Gallery, the Kostka Gallery and the Wall Gallery on the side facade), a music hall, a theatre and a residency programme with fifteen studios that host over thirty artists, curators, musicians, directors and writers a year (MeetFactory).
Board: David Černý, musician David Koller and film and theatre director Alice Nellis (MeetFactory).

name: tranzit.cz / Matter of Art Biennale
known: ERSTE Foundation names Tereza Stejskalová as a co-founder and director of tranzit.cz.

The 2024 edition, curated by Katalin Erdődi and Aleksei Borisionok, ran from 14 June to 29 September 2024 at the National Gallery Prague's Trade Fair Palace and the Lidice Gallery, organised with the National Gallery Prague and the Lidice Art Collection (e-flux).

The 2026 edition runs from 12 June to 13 September 2026, curated by Jaroslava Tomanová, Jakub Gawkowski and František Fekete, at the Trade Fair Palace, GAMPA City Gallery Pardubice and Tusculum Prague, with admission free (National Gallery Prague).
2024 edition: part of Art Space Unlimited, co-funded by the European Union; its artistic and curatorial residencies and public programme are funded by NextGenerationEU (e-flux).
